competitors.name: Smartsheet Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: SaaS-based collaboration platform with spreadsheet-like project management features, competing in workspace productivity tools with 30%+ revenue growth and 80%+ gross margins[3][10].

competitors.name: Atlassian Corporation
competitors.relevance_justification: Developer of Confluence (knowledge management) and Jira (project management) with SaaS business model, 85%+ gross margins, and $3B+ annual revenue[5][9].

competitors.name: Asana, Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: Work management platform with 40%+ revenue growth, negative EBITDA margins, and R&D-intensive SaaS model comparable to Notion's financial profile[10][13].

competitors.name: monday.com Ltd.
competitors.relevance_justification: Work OS platform with 50%+ revenue growth, 85% gross margins, and $500M+ ARR competing in customizable workspace solutions[10][13].

competitors.name: Adobe Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: Enterprise SaaS competitor through Adobe Workfront (project management) and document collaboration tools, with significant R&D investment matching Notion's 25% R&D ratio[4][9].

competitors.name: Salesforce, Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: Competes through Quip collaboration platform with similar gross margins (84%) and enterprise SaaS focus, though at larger scale[9][16].

competitors.name: Microsoft Corporation
competitors.relevance_justification: Competes via OneNote, Teams, and SharePoint with 85%+ gross margins in productivity software segment, though with diversified business model[5][9].

competitors.name: Alphabet Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: Google Workspace competes in document collaboration with 80%+ gross margins and $30B+ annual revenue in productivity tools segment[9][14].

competitors.name: Dropbox, Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: File collaboration platform with 80%+ gross margins and $2B+ revenue, though with slower growth than Notion's 40% rate[9][14].
